market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver at $120 implies a >3.6x rally from current ~$33 in just 15 months, far beyond its all‑time high near $50. The historical volatility, fundamentals, and time constraint make this scenario nearly impossible; a true probability below 0.1% is realistic.
evidence_points: Silver’s inflation‑adjusted all‑time high from 1980 is roughly $50, and $120 would double that record.
A move of this magnitude in 15 months would require an extreme global monetary or supply crisis, estimated far below a 1% chance.
The CME active‑month settlement mechanism ensures only official closing prices count, eliminating intraday spike ambiguity, but no fundamental shift supports $120.
sources_consulted: CME Silver futures contract specifications and active‑month rules
